(i) w.r.t. $t$, we get $\quad 2 A A^{\prime}=37(2 t)$ After $t=1 \mathrm{~h}$, we get $2 \sqrt{37} A^{\prime}=2(37)$ After $t=1 \mathrm{~h}$, we get $\Rightarrow \quad A^{\prime}=\sqrt{37}$ Thus, rate at which shortest distance $A$ changes with time is $\sqrt{37} \mathrm{~km} / \mathrm{h}$.

&\because \quad \theta=0, \pi, 2 \pi
\end{aligned}

Thus, total number of solutions $=7$
